{\n\t\tdifficulty = \"easy\"\n\t}\n\n\twriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{\n\t\t\"base_xp\":       baseXP,\n\t\t\"monster_count\": monsterCount,\n\t\t\"multiplier\":
